important_boundaries: Trailing zero is multiplication by X, not leading-zero padding.
All-index coefficient iff preserves actual natural-sum/residue witnesses and assumes no primality.
Nonempty-factor output has length S N and is an actual trailing-zero shift.
Either originally empty factor yields actual zero prefixes; a universal K=S N assertion is false.
Uniform output equivalence compares coefficients at every power, not sampled evaluation values or beta codes.
Raw entries outside every annotated prefix remain unconstrained.
Prime is used for canonical coefficient and actual new-product construction, including characteristic two; uniform covariance holds at any nonzero modulus.
